completeness.label: Completeness
completeness.detail: Core fields: patient, age/sex, date, hospital, doctor, diagnosis, vitals. A field counts as present when it is non-empty and not ‘Not specified’.

confidence.label: Extraction confidence
confidence.detail: base = 90 for digital/structured prescriptions, 83 for handwritten. Each field the model marked UNCLEAR removes 2.5 points. Clamped to 60–99.

review.label: Review vs auto-clear
review.formula: review if any UNCLEAR flag OR completeness < 100%
review.detail: Everything else is straight-through (auto-cleared). No confidence threshold is used — a single illegible field routes the script to a human.

case.label: Case type
case.formula: clinical chronicity, else longest item duration
case.detail: Emergency/admission markers → Acute / Emergency. A chronic-condition marker in the diagnosis (cancer, chronic, diabetes, hypertension, schizophrenia, varicose, gout…) → Chronic. Otherwise by longest item duration: ≥90 days → Chronic, 15–89 → Sub-acute, <15 → Acute.

refill.label: Refill & subscription candidate
refill.formula: any medication runs ≥ 1 month or continuous
refill.detail: Flags scripts eligible for a refill/subscription nudge based on standing therapy.

poly.label: Polypharmacy (adherence pack)
poly.detail: Counts distinct Medication-category items only (tests and supportive care excluded).

diagnostics.label: Diagnostics cross-sell
diagnostics.formula: a test item OR a recorded lab value is present
diagnostics.detail: Either an ordered diagnostic item or a numeric vital/lab reading on the script.

senior.label: Senior care candidate
senior.detail: Uses the extracted patient age. Scripts where age was not captured are excluded, not assumed.

specialty.label: Specialty pharma
specialty.detail: Flags high-touch therapeutic areas that need cold-chain handling, prior-auth support and clinical follow-up, matched on the extracted specialty area.
